mcat_description.short: PEB Structures Fabrication covers the design, factory fabrication, supply, and on-site erection of Pre-Engineered Building systems — integrated steel structures comprising primary rigid frames, secondary members (purlins, girts), and roof/wall cladding panels, delivered as a complete engineered package.
mcat_description.long: Pre-Engineered Buildings (PEBs) are factory-fabricated steel structural systems in which primary frames (columns and rafters), secondary members (purlins and girts), and cladding systems are designed as an integrated package, manufactured off-site under controlled conditions, and rapidly assembled on-site using bolted connections. Structural steel conforms to IS 2062 (grades E250/E350) for primary members and IS 801 cold-formed sections for secondary members, with overall design governed by IS 800:2007, IS 875 (wind/snow loads), and IS 1893 (seismic loads). The fabrication service typically encompasses end-to-end scope: structural design using CAD/analysis software, CNC-based steel fabrication, protective coating (epoxy/galvanised), logistics, and supervised erection. PEB structures offer clear spans up to 90 metres, faster construction timelines, and optimised steel usage compared to conventional RCC or site-fabricated steel buildings, making them the dominant choice for industrial sheds, warehouses, and logistics facilities across India.

market_context: PEB Structures Fabrication in India refers to the end-to-end service of designing, factory-fabricating, and erecting pre-engineered steel building systems — a market dominated by industrial and warehousing demand. The structural design is governed by IS 800:2007 (general steel construction), IS 875 (wind and snow loads), and IS 1893 (seismic loads); primary steel members conform to IS 2062 grades E250 or E350, while secondary cold-formed members follow IS 801. The Indian PEB market is driven by rapid industrialisation, growth of logistics and e-commerce warehousing, and the cost and speed advantages of PEB over conventional RCC construction — industry sources cite 20–40% cost savings and 50–70% shorter construction timelines. Key manufacturing hubs for PEB suppliers include Faridabad/Delhi NCR, Hyderabad, Ahmedabad, Pune, Nagpur, Chennai, and Coimbatore, consistent with the geographic keyword distribution observed. The dominant commercial model is a turnkey design-fabricate-erect contract, though component-only supply (primary frames, purlins, cladding) is also transacted. Clear spans up to 90 metres are achievable, making PEB the preferred structural solution for warehouses, factories, aircraft hangars, and large-span commercial buildings. Buyer vocabulary consistently uses 'PEB structure,' 'PEB shed,' 'pre-engineered building,' and 'steel structure shed'; technical buyers also reference IS 800 compliance, seismic zone, and wind zone as key procurement criteria.

Agent 3 should prioritise BIS standards, steel grade specifications, structural design datasheets, and fabrication process documentation.
